(yyyy)` pattern, skip sanitizer); OR (b) build whitelist for known author names + key academic terms; OR (c) make sanitizer aware of citation blocks (e.g. `> ` blockquote citations bypass). Option (a) is cleanest. Implement in scripts/feed_sanitizer or wherever the sanitizer regex lives + add 5 regression tests covering Harvey/Liu/Zhu/DM/Patton/Bollerslev citation forms.
findings: Citation-context exemption landed. publish_draft.py + publisher.py symmetrically patched (Option A regex stash/restore). 5 citation patterns (3-author/et-al/2-author/single/comma-year), ASCII+fullwidth bracket support, year-suffix variant. 25 new tests + 22/23 existing PASS (1 unrelated pre-existing fail). error_log.md +4 lessons. title: Paper review (Codex 24h-rule): LASSO 救得了波動率預測嗎？10 個因子全選了，還是輸給古老的 GARCH（K986）
description: Per .claude/rules/agent-delegation.md 2026-05-02 K1018 lesson, production article mile_912dd699 needs Codex source-code-level review within 24h of publish. Pipe article through codex exec --skip-git-repo-check with prompt requesting: (1) verify K986 numbers byte-for-byte against experiments/k986/k986_adaptive_har_results.json (QLIKE GJR=-8.527 vs HAR-3=-8.194; OOS R² 0.4653 vs 0.1895; DM=-7.24); (2) check QLIKE sign convention (lower=better) used consistently; (3) audit any overclaims about LASSO failure (must say regularization detected VIX² correctly, only model-level loss); (4) lookahead check (shift(1) on all 10 factors per script).
findings: Codex primary-path review (codex 0.121.0) — 5 points: 3 PASS + 1 MINOR + 1 MAJOR. (1) PASS numbers byte-aligned (QLIKE -8.527/-8.194/-7.453/-2.670/+2.301/+2.302/+2.447, OOS R²s, n_oos=1824, n_factors=10). (2) PASS QLIKE sign correct, avoided results.json `improvement_pct=-4.07` 語義 trap. (3) MINOR § 4 narrative over-packaging — 「呼應先前多次日頻 GARCH ceiling」太滿；K973 同 daily r² target 但 HAR > GJR — 應寫「另一個 daily noisy-proxy 下 GJR 強勢的案例」. (4) PASS VIX² 8/8 rolling 100% selection byte-aligned. (5) MAJOR shift(1) lookahead claim 太滿。10 factors feature-level lag 都做對，rolling refit 邊界也無 OOS lookahead，但 LassoCV(cv=5) / ElasticNetCV(cv=5) / KFold(shuffle=False) Ridge 都用 plain 5-fold CV → 訓練窗內較晚資料參與較早 fold alpha 選擇 = within-window CV leakage. 應改：「feature-level lag 1 期；但 hyperparameter 選擇用 5-fold CV 而非 TimeSeriesSplit」。Verdict: 主結論 (adaptive HAR no improvement, GJR wins, VIX² consistently selected) source-code 站得住，但需 errata v2 修 2 點 (narrative softening + CV-leakage caveat). 3-model review pattern (Claude → Gemini → Codex) 又一次 surface真問題.

title: K982 post-publish Codex review (24h-rule): mile_9ed87beb sector dispersion + correlation regime
description: Run Codex review on mile_9ed87beb (K982 general-audience article). Check: (1) numerical accuracy vs k982_dispersion_results.json, (2) VIX-sufficiency framing balance (positive=null=success vs negative=no improvement), (3) descriptive vs predictive distinction (regime t=13.7 IS real but VIX subsumes it), (4) shift(1) lookahead claim correctness, (5) source-code-level checks Gemini cannot do.
findings: Codex primary-path review 5 points: 1 PASS + 2 MAJOR + 2 MINOR. (1) MAJOR sample size mismatch: 文章 n=1936 / 2018-06-20 start, results.json effective n_observations=1913 / IS_period 2018-07-24 (rolling 22d + rv_future shift(-22) + predictor shift(1) 縮 sample). (2) MAJOR high-corr t=13.7 是 stats.ttest_ind(rv_future_high, rv_future_low) two-sample mean test, 不是 descriptive 也不是 incremental predictive; 而且 22-day overlapping rv_future 有自相關沒做 HAC/block bootstrap 修正 → t-stat 有 overstated 風險, "PASS Harvey 3.0" claim 太強. (3) PASS DM 4 augmented model framing 平衡 (M2/M3/M4 p>0.12). (4) MINOR strategy backtest 是 gross-of-cost, 文章沒明標 (JSON limitations 有寫). (5) MINOR regime classification 用同日 avg_corr (非 lagged) — 這對 forward sort 是 OK 因 same-day observable, 但文章 "全 shift(1)" 覆蓋過寬. Verdict: 主結論 (VIX-sufficiency confirmation) source-code 站得住, 但需 errata v2 修 4 點 (sample size + regime framing + cost caveat + lookahead 細化).
